journal:
I kept my head bowed as another painful rasp escaped into the tunnels, a thrum of energy charged from just beyond the entrance to the great hall, bristling my cloak as I tried my best to remain still, the protocols must be observed.

I knelt before a high priest, arms held palm flat against my chest as my cloak was removed.  I felt a balm being applied to the my shoulders, and the priest said a few words in quiet prayer before I recloaked and moved further into the crowd, the protocols must be observed.

I offered up my hand when asked by a fellow disciple, a long curved needle-like blade was placed on my palm and I gripped it as hard as I could. I placed my palm into a wet stone dish and was ushered forward, the protocols must be observed.

Finally, I stepped up onto a stone altar, I could feel something sinister in the air, an almost imperceptible voice whispering inside my head, gnawing at my thoughts, as I drew onto the top step more voices joined in the chorus, like sirens calling a mariner to his peril, I could not resist, I dare not, and towards an ancient manuscript carefully laid out in front of me I began to read, the protocols must be observed.
prompt: Low and close across a stone altar, the pages of an opened ancient book blaze with white light that floods up into the hooded cultist's face as his mouth falls open and his skin begins to come apart into sparks.

music.why: A hooded cultist's ritual climaxes as a blazing ancient book tears his soul apart on a stone altar, a dark, driven, dreadful moment.
